scene: Across the plank, transit platforms span the city edge.
picture: Along a wide wooden pier, a sleek yellow street tram sits on rails on the left. The young Black woman in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands in the centre. Up high hangs a glass cable car at a pylon. On the far right, a blue ferry floats beside the dock.
shown: a dangling glass cable car docked at an aerial pylon up high
a sleek yellow street tram waiting with open doors on the left
a blue passenger ferry moored at a wooden slipway on the far right
